text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Your timing was off there… You made your move far too early.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What's gotten you all flustered?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hey, are you listening?

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text: I… I'm done with this.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Excuse me?

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text: I only came to Tracen Academy because I happened to be good at running and races were kinda fun.

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text: But my mom has zero racing experience. There's absolutely nothing of note about my family.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What is your point?

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text: I'm saying I'm a nobody! No family name to uphold, no dreams to achieve! I don't have any reason to run!

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text: I'm not like you or anyone else here! There's… no place for me at this academy!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …Is that all?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Very well. We're done for today. Rest up and stay warm.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. I have two requests to make of you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: First, I'd like your permission to wear my signature racewear.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Second, I'd like to reserve your next day off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On my next day off, I head to the track like Air Groove requested.

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text: Your signature racewear looks amazing, but why are you showing it to me?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I inherited this blue and yellow design from my mother, the Queen.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: From there, I altered the design to reflect what being "the Empress" means to me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The signature racewear of an Umamusume serves as a representation of their resolve and a symbol of their dreams.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I strive to follow in the footsteps of my mother, so I move ever forward in pursuit of my ideals.

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text: …Well, good for you. But what does that have to do with—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Would someone who wishes to leave the academy—someone who's abandoned the turf—push themselves forward the way you do?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You can't fool me. Whenever you run, I sense nothing but a fierce desire to win.

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text: Ngh! So what? I—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You still claim that you have nothing to strive for? Then run with me. Right now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The Empress will show you what you claim to lack.

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text: Air Groove…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of them take off. The younger student runs with all her might, but Air Groove catches up in an instant, quickly overtaking her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The sight of Air Groove's beautiful form overwhelms the younger student, sparking something within her.

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff…
choice_data_list: She's actually quite softhearted, don't you think?
She's actually quite softhearted, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff…
choice_data_list: She's actually quite softhearted, don't you think?
She's actually quite softhearted, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text: Yeah, she is… but also cruel.

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text: She's planted seeds of motivation even in someone like me… Ugh!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Have you ever wondered why Umamusume are so fast?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Why our legs are so remarkably resilient?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It is so that we can run on our chosen paths, wherever they may lead. At least, that's what I believe.

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text: I… think I get it…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: If you have hope, then never stop. Your legs will carry you ever onward.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Do not fear the path ahead. It may be treacherous. You may stumble and fall.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: But there will always be someone there to pick you back up and support you the rest of the way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove glances over at me with a hint of a smile on her lips.

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text: She sure is. I still think it'd be a lot easier to just give up.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: If that is truly what you wish for, then I won't stop you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I don't have the time to stop for someone who has already dropped out of their race. I have my own dreams to pursue.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: However, if you still have conviction and are determined to keep moving forward… I shall be a beacon for you.

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text: Don't you ever feel unsure of yourself? Or lose sight of your goals?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'd be lying if I said I don't. I have my fair share of inadequacies and shortcomings.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: However, I will never lose sight of my aspirations.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: After all, I have a mirror right beside me.

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text: A mirror?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Always by my side, reflecting my every act and making sure that I'm still on the right track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove glances over at me with a hint of a smile on her lips.
